snippet.title: Captain Wayne Vacation Desperation - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
CAPTAIN WAYNE OUT NOW - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2319790/Captain_Wayne__Vacation_Desperation/

Batten Down the Hatches, Captain Wayne – Vacation Desperation is out now on Steam!

Hand-drawn, drenched in gore, and louder than a cannon broadside, Captain Wayne - Vacation Desperation is an over-the-top cocktail of old-school shooter carnage and cartoon chaos with a salt-sprayed twist. This isn’t your typical holiday cruise; it’s a bloodbath on the high seas, captained by a cigar-chomping menace with a shotgun arm and zero patience for scurvy dogs.
